item.title: Pineview water systems warns of $500 fine for using too much water - KSLTV.com
item.description: Pineview Water Systems sent out notices to some 16,000 of its customers who are now metered for their secondary water, letting them know that $500 fines will be charged to homeowners who use more than their allotment.

item.title: 3 kids hospitalized after being hit by cars in less than a week - KSLTV.com
item.description: Three children from three different cities are in the hospital after being hit by vehicles in separate incidents over the past several days. Police are asking drivers to be vigilant.

item.title: Ace Bailey’s career night spoiled as Raptors edge out Jazz - KSLTV.com
item.description: The Utah Jazz dropped a second straight game, falling to the Toronto Raptors at home despite another impressive showing from Ace Bailey.

item.title: Are you buying watered down fuel as gas prices surge? - KSLTV.com
item.description: Utah gas prices are knocking at $4 for a gallon of regular on average. Are you buying watered-down gas? Just how accurate are those pumps? Will it hurt your car to gas up on the lowest octane?

item.title: Utah Jazz trounced by Raptors, George out of MIP race - KSLTV.com
item.description: Ace Bailey set yet another career-high, but the Utah Jazz fell to the Toronto Raptors 143-127.

item.title: Inside Salt Lake’s Federal Reserve cash processing operation - KSLTV.com
item.description: The Federal Reserve U.S. manages monetary policy, influences interest rates and keeps cash flowing. KSL got an inside look the highly secure Salt Lake branch of the Federal Reserve Bank of San Francisco Tuesday.

item.title: Utah 2034 organizers look to boost interest in biathlon ahead of games - KSLTV.com
item.description: Looking to boost interest in biathlon in the years leading up to the Utah 2034 games, staff at Soldier Hollow let journalists try the sport Tuesday.

item.title: Utah testing snow storage technique at Soldier Hollow ahead of 2034 Games - KSLTV.com
item.description: Utah Olympic and Paralympic organizers are testing a new way to preserve snow at Soldier Hollow, hoping it could provide a backup plan for the 2034 Winter Olympic Games if warmer conditions become a concern.

item.title: Man living with ALS carried to Delicate Arch in emotional birthday trek - KSLTV.com
item.description: A dream came true for a Utah man living with ALS and confined to a wheelchair, thanks to the determination of dozens of family members and friends who helped him reach the famous Delicate Arch.

item.title: Utah Mammoth look listless in loss to Edmonton Oilers - KSLTV.com
item.description: It was all Edmonton Oilers at Delta Center on Tuesday night as the Utah Mammoth struggled to generate offense in a 5-2 loss.

item.title: Pinching pennies at the pump: How to make gas rewards work for you - KSLTV.com
item.description: In our second Pinching Pennies at the Pump report, we look into whether gas rewards programs can actually save you money.

item.title: ‘It’s on us’: Mammoth struggle at both ends, remain winless against Oilers - KSLTV.com
item.description: The best player in the world made it look easy on Tuesday night at Delta Center as Connor McDavid tallied his 400th career goal and 1,200th point in a comfortable victory over the Utah Mammoth.

item.title: Provo boy’s family breaks silence after kidnapping charges filed against local mom - KSLTV.com
item.description: A mother in Provo is speaking out after another mother at her son's school allegedly kidnapped him to force his apology to her daughter.

item.title: Pedestrian hit, killed on Redwood Road in Salt Lake City - KSLTV.com
item.description: A person was hit and killed by a vehicle in Salt Lake City on Wednesday morning.

item.title: Iran dismisses US ceasefire plan, issues counterproposal as strikes land across the Mideast - KSLTV.com
item.description: Iran on Wednesday dismissed an American plan to pause the war in the Middle East and launched more attacks on Israel and Gulf Arab countries.
